CALL TO ORDER

At 2:06 p.m., chair Jim Howat called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Howat, Rew, Lewis

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54251  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  meeting of Monday, June 24, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by , to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Rew
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

2.  24-54252  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Update.

  • The available funds for the month of May were $158,000.
  • House of Haven’s unused funds were relocated.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by , to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2 Howat, Rew

3.  24-54253  Recommendation to discuss the Mayor’s Fund utility bill envelopes and fundraising
  strategies.

  • The Subcommittee is considering changing the utility bill format.
  • The committee explored fundraising options.
  • There was a proposal for electronic donation option and adding a QR code.
  • Discussion on postcard design and fundraising. The subcommittee is
  considering a local newspaper add a story on the Mayor’s Fund.
  • City staff suggested that the mayor emphasize a different organization
  supported by the Mayor’s Fund.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Howat, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

4.  24-54254  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  Urban Social Services and Advocacy.

  • Members and staff discussed concerns around the application review
  process and having someone from the organization join the subcommittee
  meeting to answer additional questions and concerns from members of the
  subcommittee.
  • Members had questions regarding the organization’s financial stability
  beyond the 3-month period.
  • The subcommittee agreed to approve the grant for $5,000, funds will be
  released once a financial report is submitted and attendance at the next
  HSAC meeting is confirmed to address any further questions.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Howat, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Howat, Rew, Lewis

5.  24-54255  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  Prep ED Programs Inc.

  • The subcommittee is not approving the funding at this time, the application is
  still in process, they would like further information regarding their financial
  documents and contract information with LA CARE.
  • The subcommittee would like to have the applicant be present at the next
  scheduled Mayor’s Fund Meeting to address any further questions.
  • Public comment question regarding the process of mayor’s fund application
  and Brown Act rules, city staff responded.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

6.  24-54256  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  • Continue to discuss utility bill fundraising options outside of the envelopes.
  • Members of the subcommittee would like to explore a procedure where
  agency applicants attend subcommittee meetings as necessary to address
  additional questions and develop a standard operating procedure (SOP).
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
